definitions.nativeTorque: Configured targets/velocity/k/d and stiffnessErrorProxyNm are not solver-delivered native torque. Native motor/contact work is unmeasured.
definitions.window: 42 physics steps starting at first actual stand; common pre-step state, first world result through firstStand+41*DT. No new foot-mass run.
definitions.mechanicalEnergy: K + 9.81*massKg*COM.y. Mass changes remain in the window; difference is not a fixed-mass closed-system balance.
definitions.impulse: Confirmed-group upward raw-normal impulse sums current supported foot/shin/forearm contacts; wholeBodyRawGroundImpulseNs sums all raw ground-normal magnitudes. Neither is contact work.
definitions.statistics: Two deterministic controller-health scenarios with seed7; repeated clones are controls, not independent human samples.
definitions.reachCorrection: r2 observer used hipDrop .07m, while Gait uses .04m. r2 hip coordinates and all derived reach are excluded. Corrected pre-physics reach is reconstructed from stored preStand body pose and observed Gait side in analysis artifact; new driver also uses .04m.
definitions.contactPivotScope: Goal-layer supported-patch rollout retaining legacy heelOff/toePivot/IK/pinFeet. The ankle helper is inserted before legacy heel/toe adjustments, so exact pivot-preserving ankle trajectory is not established. Candidate is rejected, not repaired/tuned here.

causalPostprocessing.definition: Postprocessing only. First-step input equality proves a causal effect of the upright native constraint path on coupled mechanical response; differences are not exact native motor work. Momentum residual is not an energy supply. Long-window differences include trajectory/contact/mass feedback.
